basic_info.description: Beautifully renovated 3 bed, 2.5 bath Sunset home offering 2,285 sq ft of living space in a prime location. The main level features a bright living room with vaulted ceiling, new flooring, windows, lighting, and a preserved ornate fireplace mantel. Formal dining room with statement chandelier leads to a spacious kitchen with new cabinetry, Italian range, pro-grade hood, stunning tilework, floating shelves, and cozy breakfast room. Two oversized bedrooms, remodeled full and half baths with warm modern finishes, and generous storage complete the level. Downstairs includes permitted living space with a large sitting area, expansive family room with wet bar and laundry closet, huge bedroom or den, and a stylish new full bath. Additional upgrades include new rear siding and a low-maintenance backyard. One block from the N-Judah Muni line, two blocks to Sunset Rec Center, and just three blocks from Golden Gate Park. Enjoy nearby dining and shopping on Irving, Judah, and Noriega.
